# Normal Distribution
```{r}
# Plot the standard normal distribution (mean = 0, sd = 1)
x <- seq(-4, 4, length = 100)
y <- dnorm(x, mean = 0, sd = 1)

plot(x, y, type = "l", main = "Standard Normal Distribution", ylab = "Density")
```

```{r}
# Generate 100 random values from N(0,1)
samples <- rnorm(100, mean = 100, sd = 1)
samples
hist(samples, main = "Histogram of Random Normal Smaples", xlab = "Value")
```


```{r}
# Probability at a Point
pnorm(1.5, mean = 0, sd = 1)
```


```{r}
set.seed(7369)
n <- 1000
z <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
z
```

install.packages("skimr")
